policy: SemVer for every independently-shipped component. Each versioned wire/ABI boundary rejects unknown newer versions cleanly (no silent downgrade). Database and sync schema support an N-1/N-2 window and migrate older versions forward. Deprecated features are removed only after N+2 (two releases after deprecation notice).

gateway_protocol.note: v1 protocol: mismatched versions are rejected with VersionMismatch; the window widens as the protocol matures

abi.note: stable C ABI v1; stale headers rejected

database_schema.note: storage-sqlite Migrator applies steps from any older version; N-1/N-2 open strategies are explicit via OpenPolicy

deprecation.policy: A feature is deprecated with a notice; removal ships no earlier than N+2. Deprecated features continue to honor the compatibility window until removal.
